speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly how your gait is altered, and do you experience any numbness or weakness in your limbs? When did these symptoms first begin, and have they been progressively worsening?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That "drunk" appearance is a classic sign of ataxia; are your symptoms constant, or do they worsen with movement? Do you experience any sensory changes like numbness, tingling, or a feeling of vibration loss in your feet? Also, have you noticed any issues with your vision, speech, or balance when standing still?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with and without contrast. REQUEST TEST: CSF Analysis for JC Virus PCR.
